tools.name: smallinvoice_create_contact
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new company contact (customer) in smallinvoice, with its main address. Needs the "contact" scope. POST /contacts. Nothing is sent to anyone. Private persons are not supported here (smallinvoice needs more fields for them): create those in smallinvoice. Check smallinvoice_list_contac

tools.name: smallinvoice_create_invoice
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new invoice for a contact. Needs the "invoice" scope. POST /receivables/invoices. It is only created: it is NOT sent by e-mail or post and its status is not changed; the user reviews it in smallinvoice. Not idempotent: calling it twice creates two invoices. Use smallinvoice_list_con

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: smallinvoice_create_contact · Private data: smallinvoice_list_contacts, smallinvoice_get_contact, smallinvoice_list_contact_addresses, smallinvoice_list_contact_people, smallinvoice_list_contact_groups, smallinvoice_list_invoices, smallinvoice_list_bank_accounts, smallinvoice_create_contact, smallinvoice_create_invoice · Public sink: smallinvoice_create_contact, smallinvoice_create_invoice.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: smallinvoice_create_contact · Private data: smallinvoice_list_contacts, smallinvoice_get_contact, smallinvoice_list_contact_addresses, smallinvoice_list_contact_people, smallinvoice_list_contact_groups, smallinvoice_list_invoices, smallinvoice_list_bank_accounts, smallinvoice_create_contact, smallinvoice_create_invoice · Public sink: smallinvoice_create_contact, smallinvoice_create_invoice

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
